description: Add data-page-guide HTML attributes to all view and component files across the frontend. This gives PageGuide.tsx concrete DOM targets to spotlight for every tour step. No new elements are created except two minimal div wrappers where no DOM container exists (feed-posts in Home.tsx, orders-delivery-timeline in Orders.tsx). All other hooks are added to existing elements. FEAT-001 is independent of FEAT-002: after this commit the build stays green, and no existing behaviour changes.
